All you need for a business!!. This is the best invoice and estimate app. What makes it the best? It’s FREE and you can download your own invoice pdf and email it to your client so you KNOW the second it actually emails without any screwing around or wondering if it actually got sent!! So you’re not relying on some 3rd party garbage for your MONEY!! You can simply add your payment options in your invoice like Venmo, Zelle, cash app, Apple Pay, etc. All these invoice apps charging $100+ annually are absolutely insane, sure if you’re accepting payments through the app they could charge a small fee but why not get a check or use a different pay option. This app should just start charging a 5$ one time fee for the app and then if you want to accept payments through it do a suuuper small fee or something cause jobber and joist prices are a absolute SCAM.
